messages:
ana: FYI PR #4727 failed pre-merge scan. It flagged a file `deploy/keys/service-account.json` committed by mistake. Not in any runtime artifact yet. tagging sec.
tom: thanks. can you paste the redacted snippet and commit hash? we need to know which SA and whether private_key present.
nana: commit 7f9c2e, snippet: `{
  \"type\": \"service_account\",
  \"client_email\": \"batch-worker@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com\",
  \"private_key_id\": \"...\",
  \"private_key\": \"-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\\nMIIEvAIBADANBgkq...\\n\"
}` (redacted)
vault-bot: [Alert] repo-scan match=service_account_json path=deploy/keys/service-account.json severity=high ticket=SEC-3410
security-oncall: immediate actions: 1) mark keys compromised 2) revoke existing keys for the SA 3) rotate and avoid storing plaintext anywhere 4) run org-wide repo search for similar artifacts.
tom: I'm running `git grep -n \"service_account\" -- \"deploy/*\"` and `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=batch-worker@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-dev --format=json`
tom: found key ids [\"112233\",\"445566\"]. I'll delete them and create a new key.
ops-bot: [Action] created ticket OPS-902 for repo artifact purge and force-PR revert. Assigned=infra-ci team.
nana: don't create a plaintext newkey.json in CI. Use KMS envelope encrypt and store ciphertext in Vault. Suggest flow: generate key locally, call gcloud kms encrypt -> push ciphertext to Vault `secret/data/dev/batch-worker/wrapped`
security-oncall: agree. also tighten KMS binding: only infra-decryptor SA and ops group should have cryptoKeyDecrypter role. run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` and remove any broad principals.
ops-bot: checked KMS policy: legacy binding found `serviceAccount:legacy-deployer@external.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Removing now.
nana: enable Vault audit log on that path and set 180d retention. `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault/dev_batch_audit.log` then ship to centralized logs.
legal: loop me in if this repo is public or if partner code referenced; if public, legal needs to assess disclosure risk and notification obligations.
tom: repo is private but there is a mirrored downstream. I'll run `git log --all --full-history -- deploy/keys/service-account.json` to see exposure windows and mirrors.
ops-bot: created automated scanner rule to reject commits containing SA JSON with regex `(\\{\\s*\"type\"\\s*:\\s*\"service_account\"|\\\"private_key\\s*:)`. Rule will block at pre-merge for all repos under infra/* and deploy/*.
security-oncall: post-incident tasks: - revoke and rotate SA keys - store wrapped ciphertext in Vault - update repo scanner + pre-merge hooks - run org-wide repo sweep for any other SA JSON - run tabletop and update runbook with example KMS+Vault flow.
nana: quick in-line runbook snippet for rotation: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create - --iam-account=batch-worker@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-dev | gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=dev-keys --key=wrap --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- | vault kv put secret/dev/batch-worker wrapped=@-` (illustrative; ensure pipes handle binary safely)
tom: timeline: detected 1795000001, keys revoked 1795000600, repo purge + PR revert 1795001200, wrapped ciphertext stored 1795001500. filing SEC-3410 with details.
legal: thanks. please add the repo mirror list to SEC-3410 and I'll advise if notifications required.
security-oncall: closing note: enforce terraform linting to forbid keyfile patterns, add build artifact scan, and schedule RBAC review for KMS keys next sprint. good catch. :white_check_mark:
